name: Gozo, Malta

visa.notes: Malta Retirement Programme requires property purchase/rental + €14,318/year income. Gozo qualifies for reduced property requirements.

rent.notes: 2-bed apartments in Gozo EUR 700-1,000 (FreeMalta Apr 2026), from EUR 850 (Frank Salt Feb 2026), EUR 900-1,400 with farmhouses/townhouses EUR 1,200-2,000 (Sauerborn Mar 2026); Housing Authority 2023 medians EUR 550-834 by village. Pet-friendly 2-3BR with outdoor space for a large dog skews to houses, hence typical above the apartment median.

groceries.notes: Couple's food shop in Malta EUR 80-140/week, budgets EUR 400 (conservative) / 600 (comfortable) per month (Sauerborn 2026); Freenance EUR 280-420 per person. Plus ~13 kg/month large-breed kibble for a 100 lb dog: Royal Canin Maxi 12 kg EUR 80-84 => ~EUR 90/mo. Gozo supermarkets (Arkadia, Lidl Victoria) slightly cheaper than Sliema. Food inflation Sept 2026 only 2.5% HICP / 3.4% RPI y/y (NSO).

utilities.notes: ARMS Residential tariff (registered residents): electricity EUR 0.1047/kWh first band, 0.1298 next; water EUR 1.40/m3 + EUR 41.43/yr service; no gas heating, electric A/C for cooling and winter heat; municipal waste collection is free. Guides: electricity+water EUR 80-150 (Frank Salt), EUR 150/250/400 for two adults with summer A/C adding EUR 150-400 in Jul-Aug (Sauerborn). Excludes internet. Gozo houses are larger and stone-built, so winter electric heating offsets lower A/C use.

healthcare.notes: US retirees on a self-sufficiency/retirement residence permit are NOT covered by the Maltese public system (Mater Dei is free only for insured workers/EU S1 holders), so this is the full comprehensive private premium for two 60-year-olds. Guides put comprehensive cover at EUR 1,500-4,000/yr per healthy adult (Sauerborn, Mar 2026) and a couple at EUR 1,500-3,000/yr (Rozie); GasanMamo quotes residency-minimum plans at EUR 180-400; local insurers often cap entry at age 60-70 so an expat insurer (Bupa, Cigna, Feather) may be needed. Old stored notes wrongly assumed free NHS access.

petCare.notes: Malta vet price list: consult EUR 30-50, yearly DHPPi/lepto EUR 40, leishmania (sandfly, needed in Malta) EUR 100, kennel cough EUR 45, rabies EUR 45, CBC EUR 30, chemistry EUR 50. Annual vaccines/checks ~EUR 300-350 for a giant breed plus year-round flea/tick/heartworm preventives (est. EUR 25-35/mo) and one bloodwork gives ~EUR 950/yr; Bernese breed-risk pushes max.

petDaycare.notes: Kennel boarding for a large/XL dog EUR 22-25/day + 18% VAT (~EUR 26-30) at Tattarga Kennels; home-sitter boarding EUR 18-35/night and daycare EUR 15-30/day (Petme 2026), large dogs at top of range. Modelled as ~2 daycare days/month plus ~15-20 boarding nights/yr averaged.

petGrooming.notes: Victoria (Gozo) salon: full groom large dog long hair from EUR 65, cabin dryer +EUR 10; wash-only long coat from EUR 30. Double-coated Bernese every 6-8 weeks ~EUR 75 incl. dryer => ~EUR 55/mo. Malta-island salons not price-listed online; assumed similar.

transportation.notes: A car is needed in Gozo. Petrol EUR 1.34/L (EU Oil Bulletin Oct 2026), ~600-800 km/mo => EUR 55-75 fuel; car insurance EUR 300-700/yr (Rozie 2026); road licence and servicing est. EUR 40-60/mo; Gozo Channel car+driver EUR 15.70 return (resident rates lower), foot passengers EUR 4.65 return but free for resident seniors 60+; Tallinja bus free/capped for resident card holders.

entertainment.notes: GO Fibre 1 Gbps EUR 49.99/mo (500 Mbps EUR 39.99); streaming EUR 15-30; dining out for two EUR 50-80 per meal at a good local restaurant (Sauerborn), modelled as 2-3 dinners/month at Gozo prices; gym EUR 25-65/mo (Rozie 2026). Gozo dining and activities cheaper than Sliema; fewer venues.

medicalOOP.notes: Private GP consultation EUR 25-50 (Mondassur); specialists, dental and physio are paid out of pocket or above insurance excess. Public pharmacy/primary care not available to non-EU self-sufficient residents, so OOP is slightly higher than the stored value.

healthcare.system: Gozo General Hospital for basic care. Mater Dei Hospital on Malta main island (30 min ferry) for specialist care.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 2-8 weeks. Complex cases require ferry to Malta main island.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: Public healthcare provides free prescriptions on approved list

pros: English spoken, very safe, warm climate

cons.text: Dependent on ferry to Malta for specialist healthcare and shopping
Can feel isolated, especially in winter
Safety & crime: see cited reports for current figures by city and country
